notes.title: Taurus VR Friend or Foe Seasonal Event Begins!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36382234/915217df2b4e91ed7a6d1c090fb2e73396fd7a65.png

First Tier of Taurus VR Content Roadmap now available for Steam Early Access Owners!

London, UK, May 2020
Nusakan Studio and Perp Games are delighted to reveal that Taurus VR has received a major new Friend or Foe Seasonal Update on Steam Early Access.

The Friend or Foe event is designed to encourage competition with a new point-based system added to the leaderboards. 

Nusakan Studios have introduced a brand new environment to the game which has very dark and swampy vibes.

A new mystery spaceship, known only as the Taur-20, has also been added to the game and can be unlocked if you beat the score of Nusakan Studio’s finest pilot who has 3,120 points! 

The final release of Taurus VR is expected Summer 2020 on the Steam and will be compatible with all major PC headsets.

The new update also coincides with a price drop on Steam Early Access, and Taurus VR is now available for £4.64.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KnjmVKwlsok&feature=youtu.be

Taurus VR is retro reimagined for VR with its focus on arcade-style space shooting action and an emphasis on 6-degree body movement that really gets your adrenaline pumping. 

Taurus VR pits you against an ever-present alien threat, requiring the player to use full-body movement to steer the ship and arm gestures to fulfil the attack and defensive mechanisms. 

During the game’s Early Access period, Nusakan Studio have an extensive and generous content roadmap laid out, leading into the game’s full launch in the summer of 2020. 

Taurus VR currently features four worlds and six spaceships. Each spaceship has unique properties, with some better suited to certain encounters than others. 

With the release of this first tier, there are still a further three tiers on the content roadmap leading into launch. The final release of Taurus VR is expected to have five worlds, nine spaceships with additional mods, as well as boss battles, seasonal events and much more. Purchasing Taurus VR during the Early Access period will represent incredible value for money with the amount of content being generated by Nusakan Studio.

Of the announcement, Jaime Núñez, Creative Director at Nusakan Studios says “Adding seasonal events shows our ongoing commitment to making Taurus VR bigger and better, adding fresh content all the time. With a brand new ship, environment, and point-based leaderboard, you can try lots of new things. But I recommend you unlock all the other spaceships and worlds first so you’re fully prepared for the challenges that await in the Friend or Foe update. Do your best, pilot.”

notes.title: Taurus VR v0.1.02 - January 31, 2020
notes.content:
Early Access - Version 0.1.02

January 31, 2020
------------------------------------


 Minor coding settings for better performance

 The bug that prevented structures loaded by the snails in the levels of Fyluck from being shown is now fixed.

 Minor internal adjustements to improve the sound system

 Due date to get the reward icon Pioneer’s badge. From now on, finishing the tutorial on normal difficulty will only reward you with credits.

notes.title: Taurus VR v0.1.01 - January 28, 2020
notes.content:
Early Access - Version 0.1.01 
January 28, 2020
------------------------------------


There have been adjustments in the way that the sum of points per world and total leaderboard points are displayed

There’s a new warning message next to the score screen at the end of each level indicating that it was not possible to check if the event is active or not

New features paving the road for future events have been added

There has been improvements in code optimisation

Some spelling and gramma mistakes have been corrected

There has been some colour adjustments to the Leaderboard Icons

notes.title: First Contact Event
notes.content:
You know the drill: Complete the missions and you’ll earn exclusive rewards. 

We have 3 unique missions ready for you at this event:

Earn the Pioneer’s badge: This exclusive badge is a token of appreciation to those pilots that dare to enter the Early Access period before anybody else. We will make it easy for you to start with. Complete the basic training from Jan 17th to Jan 31st and you’ll unlock a unique leaderboard icon that proves you support to the project from the beginning. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36382234/79e7726b67301bfed2a8bac9c22a259db22abcc7.png

Capture the Alien Spaceship: To complete the second one you will need some experience and commitment to the cause. Reach Fyluk and complete it in hard level of difficulty. If  succeed you will unlock the new spaceship. You better hurry, this mission will only be available until the next update.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36382234/9e4d424e556a3b0d20ec6efe6144bd6c9179d6ba.png


Can you Make History?: This one is not for the faint-hearted. Only by being the best and and very lucky you’ll earn this honour. Be in the Top 100 scorers from Jan 17th to Feb 14th for a chance to name the upcoming Fifth World. Do you think you’ve got what it takes, ‘pilot’? 

Here at Nusakan Studio can’t wait to see you in action. Now take that spaceship and turn those aliens into galactic ashes!!
